System Architecture of YURI:
10 Layers / 242 organs (as of now)
The all in one that the future of AI use needs.
- Learning & continuity (5)
- Self-Improvement (10)
- Hidden / Meta / Self-referential (16)
- Governance & Safety (18)
- Retrieval & Knowledge (26)
- Token-Efficiency & Session (27)
- Memory & Subconscious (28)
- Cognition & Persona (31)
- Energy & Math (39)
- Skills & Orchestration (42)

The bracketed numbers are the amount of dedicated organs per layer, nearly every organ contains up to hundreds of mechanisms that are all in tune with one another like Swiss Clockwork
You throw in any AI and it will be able to navigate and use that what is needed for the task at hand. This goes beyond any typical agentic harness that is out on the market, this is true deterministic governance at play that wraps around any LLM and SLM
